description: This line plot, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four components of a transformer model: attn_output (blue dashed line), attn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dashed line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 with tick marks approximately every 5 units. The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," scaled linearly from 0 to 1600. The plot shows that for all four lines, activation values remain near zero up to layer 5. After layer 5, all lines exhibit a sharp rise, reaching peak values between layers 6 and 10, with the ffn_residual (red) and attn_residual (orange) lines reaching approximately 1550 and 1500, respectively. The ffn_output (green) line also rises sharply, peaking around 1100 at layer 6 before dropping to near zero by layer 10. The attn_output (blue) line remains near zero until layer 20, then rises to approximately 250. The ffn_residual (red) line remains high from layer 6 to layer 20, then declines sharply after layer 20, dropping to approximately 550 at layer 22. The attn_residual (orange) line follows a similar trend to the ffn_residual, peaking around 1550 and declining to approximately 550 at layer 22. The ffn_output (green) line remains low until layer 10, then rises to approximately 1000 at layer 15 before declining again. The attn_output (blue) line remains low until layer 20, then rises to approximately 250.
